notes.text: דוד משה means Moses’ uncle, not the two personal names David Moshe. שמות פ״ו-יח is Exodus chapter 6 verse 18, not a work called Shemot numbered 86–18. Supplied יח differs from earlier machine וח; no named edition is independently checked.

כח.. gives Sukkah 28a under the period convention with doubled terminal punctuation, without independent named-edition verification. The biblical uncle and Yonatan’s patronymic are separate references, with no identity merge or added personal title. The source heading comma is presented as an English period.
